metadata.description: Local marketplace for developing this plugin against its own checkout (#607). Points 'oss' at the directory this file ships in, rather than at a GitHub release, so `/plugin marketplace add /path/to/this/checkout` followed by `/plugin install oss@claude-oss-dev` resolves commands, skills and agents from the working tree itself -- an edit here is live in the next session, with no release required. This is a contributor route, not a replacement for the README's marketplace install: a maintainer running this loop against a DIFFERENT repository should use `dpt-plugins`, the tagged, released marketplace, because that is what the loop's own currency and release tooling assume the installed copy to be.

plugins.name: oss
plugins.description: Run an open-source repo as its maintainer: triage the tracker, delegate the work, review hard, merge on green. One loop, one version, per-repo differences in config instead of prose. (Local/dev source -- resolves from this checkout, not a release.)
